name: Backup and Recovery Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of backup systems and disaster recovery infrastructure. Covers backup server hardening, credential and access controls, backup data encryption, network segmentation of backup infrastructure, immutable backup validation, and resilience against ransomware and destructive attacks.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to backup and recovery security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands backup architecture, common platforms, and security concerns
evidence: Can explain backup types (full, incremental, differential) and retention concepts
Understands why backup infrastructure is a high-value target for attackers
Familiar with common backup platforms (Veeam, Commvault, Veritas)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews backup system configurations under supervision
evidence: Reviews backup server access controls and network placement under guidance
Assesses backup encryption configurations using lab checklists
Documents backup security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses backup infrastructure security and ransomware resilience
evidence: Independently evaluates backup server hardening and access control effectiveness
Assesses backup data encryption at rest and in transit
Evaluates immutable backup configurations and air-gapped storage
Produces compliant backup security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex backup environments; simulates destructive attack scenarios; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-site backup and replication architectures
Simulates ransomware attack paths targeting backup infrastructure
Reviews backup assessment work of junior analysts
Evaluates disaster recovery plan effectiveness through tabletop exercises

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab backup assessment methodology; publishes research on backup security
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's backup security assessment framework
Published research on backup infrastructure attack techniques or defense strategies
Trains teams on backup and recovery security assessment
Recognized as authority on backup infrastructure security and resilience

assessment_methods.description: Assess a backup infrastructure environment and identify all paths an attacker could use to compromise or destroy backups
Given a backup architecture diagram, identify ransomware resilience gaps and recommend immutability controls
